ModMetaData.name: CE Fix: Milira Float Unit Elevation
ModMetaData.author: Meidocho (local patch)
ModMetaData.description: Raises CE collision and shooting height by 0.5 cells for non-flying pawns with the Milira_FloatUnit body, including Milira Race and Milian Modification float units. Adds a configurable auto-target policy for those same pawns. Native flying pawns use CE's own height rule; plants, weapons, damage, and manual targeting are unchanged.
